description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'EditorPanel' for a note-taking application's front-end. It manages note editing, including viewing, saving, deleting, and regenerating summaries, interacting with a shared store and utilizing imported utilities.

classes.name: EditorPanel
classes.description: A LightningComponent that provides UI and logic for editing notes, including title, content, and summary, with actions like save, delete, and regenerate summary.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with the currently selected note from the store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current title and content to the selected note in the store.

methods.name: regenerateSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary from the current content using the summarize utility.

methods.name: clearOrNew
methods.description: Clears current note fields or creates a new note if none is selected.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note from the store.
